content:
Vidyard is an AI-powered business video platform. It helps sales, marketing, customer success and revenue teams. They can use this platform to make, share, manage and personalise video communications at scale. Vidyard is made mainly for B2B organisations.  

In fact, it transforms video from a simple communication tool into a revenue-driving asset. At the same time, it directly integrates with CRM, sales engagement, and marketing automation platforms

How does Vidyard work?

Vidyard works in four simple stages:

  • Video creation- Vidyard helps to record webcam videos, screen recordings, or combine them. This can be done using browser extensions, desktop apps, or mobile apps.
  • Presentations and Optimisation- It can enhance videos. This can be done using custom thumbnails, chapters, playlists, captions, branding, and interactive CTA.
  • Distribution and Sharing- The platform can share videos through different means. It can be email, CRM, sales engagement, landing pages, etc.
  • Analytics and Engagement Tracking: Vidyard monitors viewer behaviour in real time.

Core Capabilities

Video Recording and Creation

Vidyard makes screen recordings, webcam tutorials, product demos, and more.

AI Video Generation

It can help users use AI to make Avatars, voice cloning, script generation, and automated capabilities.

Video Hosting and Management

The platform can store, organise, manage and share videos. This is done from a centralized cloud-based library.

Interactive Video Experience

Vidyard embeds forms, meeting schedulers, links and more in the video player. 

Revenue Intelligence

It can monitor viewer engagement and connect video interactions to sales or marketing campaigns. 

What makes Vidyard different?

  • Revenue-Focused Video Platform- Vidyard is made to help marketers in increases and revenue. 
  • Buyer Intent Tracking: It provides a detailed view of analytics. This can include important data such as replay behaviour or drop-off points. 
  • Deep CRM Integration- The platform directly integrates with popular CRMs.
  • AI-Powered Personalisation- Vidyard uses AI to make Avatars. It also uses automated personalisation to scale one-to-one video outreach. 
  • Conversion Elements- Vidyard enables companies to add booking links, forms, and CTAs to videos.

Key Services

  • Personalised Video Outreach- Vidyard makes custom sales and prospecting videos. In turn, it helps to improve engagement and response rates. 
  • Video Hosting and Distribution - It hosts, manages, and shares videos in secure brand environments. 
  • Customer Success Enablement - Vidyard is easy to use for creating onboarding tutorials, product demos, and even training videos. 
  • Marketing Video Management: It helps create lead-generation campaigns, webinars, etc. In fact, it saves marketers the time and effort

Advanced Capabilities

  • AI Video Agents- Vidyard automatically makes custom videos. They use AI avatars for it. They are especially based on CRM triggers and customer data. 
  • Dynamic Personalisation- It enables users to add prospect names, company details, account information, etc. 
  • Advanced CRM Object Sync- The platform captures video engagement data as custom CRM objects. In turn, it helps in advanced reporting and workflow automation. 
  • Real-Time Buyer Signals- Vidyard makes real-time alerts about lead behaviour. It is when prospects watch, replay, or engage with videos. 
  • API and Developer Platform - Users directly have access to APIs, webhooks, and developer tools.

Best-fit Industries

  • Saas and Technology firms that want to make product demos or onboarding, videos
  • Financial Services trying to personalise client communication or create instructional content for greater visibility.
  • Professional Services who have to make consulting presentations or virtual proposals.
  • Health Technology brands for customer education, training programs, and stakeholder engagement. 

Key Use Cases

  • Sales Prospecting - Vidyard helps businesses increase conversions with personalised outreach videos. In turn, it increases email opens, replies and meeting bookings. 
  • Product Demos- It gives self-guided product walkthroughs. In this, marketers can give feature explanations. 
  • Proposal and Pricing Reviews - Vidyard helps businesses walk their prospects through proposals, explain pricing models, and more. 
  • Customer Onboarding- Vidyard gives setup tutorials and training resources to guide customers.

Pros

  • Advanced buyer engagement analytics 
  • AI-powered video personalization 
  • Interactive in-video CTAs
  • Enterprise-grade security controls

Considerations

  • Premium features have higher price 
  • Needs CRM and workflow configuration 
  • Complex than basic tools

Top Competitors

  1. Loom- Ideal for lightweight screen recording.
  2. Sendspark- It focuses on custom outbound video at scale
  3. Hippo Video- The platform has strong automation capabilities 
  4. Storylane- It has exceptional interactive product demo platform

Conclusion

Vidyard is a specialised video engagement platform. It is made to help B2B companies turn video into measurable revenue channels. In turn, the platform's marketing teams aim to increase growth, improve customer engagement, and shorten sales cycles. 

Do you want to increase your engagement, get more qualified opportunities, and scale video-driven selling? Vidyard helps the tool to make it happen.
